item.title: Academic Success Retreat, Hosted by Student Success Center
item.description: Hosted by the Student Success Center on Sunday, August 30, from 1:00–5:30 p.m. in DCC 318, this retreat is open to all students. The retreat is designed to help students rebuild their academic self-efficacy and confidence so they can proactively shape and rewrite their educational trajectory. Presentations are intentionally designed to help students identify specific obstacles impacting their academic performance while recognizing their personal strengths and connecting with campus support…

item.title: Paris Syndrome | Miho Hatori
item.description: Date: Friday, September 4, 2026 9:00 PM - Following the success of her multimedia project Salon Mondialité, musician and artist Miho Hatori returns with the world premiere of Paris Syndrome, an EMPAC-commissioned performance created with Michiko Ogawa (shô) and Dan Peck (tuba). Surrounded by shifting fields of live sound, voice, and image, join us and encounter what happens when perception begins to slip. One show only. Included with festival pass.

item.title: Sabbath Queen: In-person screening followed by Q&A with Director, Sandi Dubowski and Rabbi Amichai Lau-Lavie
item.description: Join us on August 27 at 7pm at Scene One Spectrum Theater for an in-person screening followed by Q&A with Director, Sandi Dubowski and Rabbi Amichai Lau-Lavie. Filmmaker Sandi DuBowski follows Amichai Lau-Lavie’s journey from radical drag queen to influential Rabbi of a God-optional, artist-driven New York synagogue. To watch Lau-Lavie interrogate the questions we must all face regardless of our faith—questions of who we are and who we will be—is a deeply stimulating and moving experience.

item.title: JEC East-Side Elevated Walkway Update
item.description: Construction continues on the elevated walkway between the Darrin Communications Center (DCC) and the Jonsson Engineering Center (JEC). One half of the south side is anticipated to reopen for pedestrian traffic by August 28. The north half and area beneath the walkway will remain closed. Periodic full closures may be necessary. Please follow posted signage and alternate pedestrian routes. Completion is anticipated in November.
item.author: Community

item.title: Houston Field House Scheduled Power Shutdown – August 25
item.description: A scheduled power shutdown will occur at the Houston Field House beginning at 7:00 a.m. on Tuesday, August 25, 2026, to accommodate necessary electrical work. During the shutdown, the building will operate on limited backup generator power for the remainder of the day while the work is completed. Some building systems and services may be temporarily unavailable or affected during this time.

item.title: Celebrating the Retirement of Steve Schwan
item.description: After 27 years of dedicated service to RPI, Steve Schwan will retire on September 15. Please stop by anytime on Wednesday, September 2, from 2:00–4:00 p.m. at the Heffner Alumni House – Great Room to congratulate Steve, celebrate his many contributions, and wish him all the best in retirement.

item.title: Freshman Convocation – Class of 2030
item.description: Date: Wednesday, August 26, 2026 6:00 PM - 7:30 PM - Freshman Convocation officially welcomes Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute’s incoming first-year students to the campus community. Held just before the start of classes, the ceremony features remarks from Institute leadership, a keynote address, and a welcome from the Grand Marshal, celebrating the beginning of each student’s academic journey. An ice cream dessert reception follows the ceremony.

item.title: Rensselaer Faculty and Staff Quick Learn Webinar - Ways to Engage Students with Reading Assignments and Micro Video Lectures
item.description: Date: Wednesday, August 26, 2026 12:30 PM - 1:00 PM - Assigning reading assignments and micro video lectures prior to class is always a great option to allow students to gather initial knowledge. This session will review some tips on how we can engage and motivate the students through these readings or video lectures to guide them in pulling out the important details/understandings. item.description: Description: Our success, both personally and professionally, is largely determined by our ability to communicate effectively with a variety of people. item.title: Heliocampus Fall 2026 Syllabus Available - Complete by September 10
item.description:
The HelioCampus syllabus module is now available for faculty to access for the fall semester. Based on the requirements from the Provost’s office, faculty should have their syllabi published in HelioCampus by September 10, 2026. HelioCampus will publish all syllabi automatically on September 17, 2026.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
